title: Changing an answer, republishing, Mark OK and long text with follow-ups
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. A filled inspection where a response can be changed; a republished template with an inspection already running; the S18 Mark OK; a very long instruction; and a missing stored file.
custom_steps:
1. Change the response and confirm the acknowledgement given on the previous one is cleared, and answering the same response again asks for it afresh.
2. Add or edit a follow-up after republishing and confirm it does not reach an inspection already running (it keeps its template version).
3. Use the one-press Mark OK of S18 and confirm it can reveal collapsed instructions but never creates an acknowledgement the technician has not seen.
4. Confirm a very long instruction renders in full (with the file row and acknowledgement below, unscrolled and untruncated); and a missing stored file opens to a message rather than a broken download.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Changing the response clears the acknowledgement given on the previous one, and answering the same response again asks for it afresh.
  • A follow-up added or edited after a template is republished does not reach an inspection already running, because it keeps the template version it started on.
  • The one-press Mark OK sets OK only and never overwrites a verdict already given, so it can reveal collapsed instructions but never creates an acknowledgement the technician has not seen.
  • A very long instruction renders in full with the file row and the acknowledgement below it, unscrolled and untruncated.
  • If the stored file is missing while the follow-up still refers to it, opening it fails with a message rather than a broken download.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-10243 (S19 — Conditional follow-up on a checkbox response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S19; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-E1: “Changing the response clears the acknowledgement given on the previous one. Answering the same response again asks for it afresh”
  • S19-E2: “A follow-up added or edited after a template is republished does not reach an inspection already running, because an inspection keeps the template version it started on”
  • S19-E3: “The one-press Mark OK of S18 sets OK only and never overwrites a verdict already given, so it can reveal collapsed instructions but can never create an acknowledgement the technician has not seen”
  • S19-E4: “A very long instruction renders in full with the file row and the acknowledgement below it, unscrolled and untruncated”
  • S19-E5: “Where the stored file is missing while the follow-up still refers to it, opening it fails with a message rather than a broken download, as S11-E4 already requires”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
